checked_claims.statement: Under (N) and (R), the balanced relations bundle gives the asserted CE quadric-section bound.

checked_claims.note: The factorization through the hyperelliptic cover yields the stated splitting and a 9-versus-7 section contradiction with CLM-0080-1.
checked_claims.statement: A hyperelliptic genus-6 fibre cannot occur in the balanced tetragonal family.

checked_claims.note: The hyperelliptic alternative is excluded, Clifford forces h^0(D)=2, and the imported identity h^0(L)=1+h^0(M) gives h^0(L)=3.
checked_claims.statement: Every fibre has h^0(O(D))=2 and h^0(L)=3, so B_4 is empty.

checked_claims.note: The pencil trick and section counts force splitting type (2,3,4); seven relevant quadratic monomials map into a six-dimensional vanishing subspace, contradicting balancedness.
checked_claims.statement: A smooth plane-quintic fibre cannot occur in the balanced tetragonal family.

checked_claims.note: A base point would produce a g^2_5; Clifford then makes it base-point-free and birational onto a smooth plane quintic, which CLM-0080-4 excludes.
checked_claims.statement: The complete linear system |L_b| is base-point-free on every geometric fibre.

checked_claims.note: Constant h^0=3 permits Grauert on reduced B, and the imported Abel-Jacobi identification supplies I=P((pi_*L)^vee). Projective-bundle component and relative-dimension statements follow componentwise.
checked_claims.statement: Over reduced B, pi_*L is rank three with base change and I is the asserted relative P^2-bundle with the stated relative component dimensions.

checked_claims.note: Base-point-freeness and characteristic-zero Bertini give fibrewise density. The torsor is used only at stack level, with no unilateral reduction and no descent to coarse moduli.
checked_claims.statement: The reduced-support incidence is fibrewise dense and Z_ev is the nonempty finite etale stack-level S_6-torsor asserted in (C).

checked_claims.note: The evaluation kernel is locally free of rank two and describes the incidence. For irreducible B, the degree-six etale cover over I^dist is connected, giving transitive monodromy; orbit decomposition of the stack-level ordering torsor gives [S_6:G] components of degree |G|.
checked_claims.statement: The universal divisor, its P^1-bundle description, transitive six-sheet monodromy, and the [S_6:G] component formula hold as asserted.

checked_claims.note: Degree factorization leaves only degrees 1, 2, and 3; singular low-degree image alternatives reduce to the excluded hyperelliptic case. The ordered-pair incidence proves 2-transitivity in the birational case. The splitting is over Q and does not assert an integral decomposition.
checked_claims.statement: The birational, bielliptic, and trigonal alternatives are exhaustive, and case (i) has 2-transitive monodromy with the stated rational permutation-local-system splitting.

checked_claims.note: Three distinct gamma-images and one unramified marked point kill deck and target automorphisms. The two exceptional loci are proper closed subsets of each geometric fibre, so only density—not universal triviality—is claimed.
checked_claims.statement: The stabilizer criterion and fibrewise-dense trivial-stabilizer locus in (F) hold.

checked_claims.note: The identity omega_C(-Gamma)=O_C(D) and h^0(D)=2 recover the complete pencil up to Aut(P^1). The conclusion is restricted to geometric points and does not upgrade to monomorphism, full faithfulness, quasi-finiteness, or a Gysin statement.
checked_claims.statement: The tetragonal pencil is recovered from every geometric ordered incidence point, giving singleton geometric fibres of the classifying map.

strongest_attack: The strongest attack is the stack-versus-coarse and automorphism bookkeeping behind the S_6-torsor, the [S_6:G] component count, and the distinction between invariants and coinvariants. It does not defeat the theorem: the torsor and monodromy arguments remain explicitly stack-level, while stabilizers are handled fibrewise and only on a dense open; no coarse descent or integral unordered-cohomology decomposition is asserted. The rational permutation-local-system splitting in (E)(i) is correctly limited to Q. Cohomological/Borel-Moore degree conversion, Poincare and Tate twists, Gysin/Kunneth shifts, spectral-sequence degeneration, semisimplification of Hodge structures, motivic predictions, algebraic or tautological generation, and stable-pair boundary contributions are outside the exact theorem statement and are expressly not used to prove it.
theorem_statement: Let k be a field of characteristic zero, B a locally Noetherian k-scheme (or locally Noetherian algebraic k-stack with a smooth atlas), pi:C->B smooth proper with geometrically connected genus-6 fibres, and gamma:C->P^1_B finite flat of degree 4 whose Casnati-Ekedahl relations bundle is fibrewise balanced, F_b iso O(4) direct-sum O(5). Let 0->W_4->W->W_5->0 be the canonical filtration of ATT-0065/CLM-0065-5 (dual-confirmed REV-0108, REV-0109), L:=W_5 tensor omega_{C/B}^{-1}, M:=omega_{C/B}^{tensor 2} tensor W_5^vee, and let I:=Hilb^6(C/B) x_{Pic^6(C/B)} B be the Abel-Jacobi incidence over the section [L], I^dist its distinct-support open, and Z_ev:=Conf_6(C/B) x_{Hilb^6(C/B)} I the ordered incidence of ATT-0066/(H4) (dual-confirmed REV-0110, REV-0116). Assume, exactly as in the dependency package and NOT proved here, (N) the fibrewise weak CE relative-canonical normalization O_{P(E_b^vee)}(1)|_{C_b} iso omega_{C_b/P^1} tensor gamma_b^*A_b, and (R) that the ideal of the fibrewise CE embedding has the standard degree-four resolution 0->O_X(-4) tensor p^*det F->O_X(-2) tensor p^*F->I_C->0 on the P^2-bundle X=Proj_{P^1}(Sym E) with p_*O_X(1)=E. Then, with every dimension statement taken componentwise and RELATIVE to B (no absolute dimension of B is asserted): (A) for every geometric point b of B the curve C_b is neither hyperelliptic nor isomorphic to a smooth plane quintic; (B) consequently h^0(O_{C_b}(D_b))=2 and h^0(L_b)=3 for every geometric point b, so the jump stratum B_4={h^0(L)=4} is EMPTY, and over B reduced pi_*L is locally free of rank 3 compatibly with base change and I iso P((pi_*L)^vee) is a Zariski-locally trivial P^2-bundle over ALL of B, smooth and proper of pure relative dimension 2, whose irreducible components are exactly the preimages of the irreducible components of B, of dimension dim(component of B)+2; (C) the complete linear system |L_b| is base-point-free on every geometric fibre, hence in characteristic zero its reduced-support locus is a dense open subset of |L_b| iso P^2, hence I^dist is a dense open subscheme of I meeting every geometric fibre, I^dist->B is surjective, the components of I^dist correspond bijectively to those of B with the same dimensions, and Z_ev->I^dist is a finite etale S_6-torsor at stack level which is nonempty over every geometric point of B and equidimensional of the same dimension; (D) over B reduced the universal degree-six divisor script-D inside C x_B I is finite locally free of degree 6 over I, etale exactly over I^dist, and is canonically the Zariski-locally trivial P^1-bundle P(K^vee) over C with K:=ker(pi^*pi_*L->L) locally free of rank 2, so the irreducible components of script-D correspond bijectively to those of B; and if B is irreducible then script-D, I and I^dist are irreducible, the etale monodromy rho:pi_1^et(I^dist)->S_6 of the six points has TRANSITIVE image G, and Z_ev has exactly [S_6:G] irreducible components, each finite etale of degree |G| over I^dist; (E) for every geometric point b exactly one of the following holds for the morphism phi_{L_b}:C_b->P^2 defined by the base-point-free complete g^2_6 |L_b|: (i) phi_{L_b} is birational onto a plane sextic of arithmetic genus 10 with total delta-invariant 4, (ii) phi_{L_b} is 2:1 onto a smooth plane cubic, so C_b is bielliptic and L_b=p_b^*N_b with deg N_b=3 on the elliptic quotient, or (iii) phi_{L_b} is 3:1 onto a smooth conic, so C_b is trigonal and L_b=2T_b; and in case (i) the monodromy of the six points over |L_b|^dist is 2-transitive, hence primitive, so the rank-6 permutation local system splits as Q direct-sum (an irreducible rank-5 system); (F) if (C,gamma,Gamma) is a geometric point of Z_ev whose ordered reduced divisor Gamma has at least three distinct gamma-images and at least one point at which gamma is unramified, then Aut(C,gamma,Gamma)=1, and the natural homomorphism Aut(C,gamma,Gamma)->Aut(C,Gamma) is an isomorphism, so the associated geometric point of M_{6,6} also has trivial automorphism group; moreover on every geometric fibre the set of reduced Gamma in |L_b| violating either condition is contained in a proper closed subset (the all-points-ramified locus is finite, and the at-most-two-distinct-images locus is empty when h^0(O(3D_b) tensor omega_b^{-1})=0 and otherwise has dimension at most 1, since h^0(O(3D_b) tensor omega_b^{-1}) is at most 1 by (A)), so the trivial-stabilizer locus is a dense open subset of every geometric fibre of Z_ev->B; and (G) for every geometric point of Z_ev one has omega_C(-Gamma) iso O_C(D) with h^0=2, so |omega_C(-Gamma)| is the complete base-point-free pencil defining gamma and gamma is determined by (C,Gamma) up to Aut(P^1); consequently the classifying map on geometric points to M_{6,6} is injective with every geometric fibre a single isomorphism class, now unconditionally rather than only over an h^0=3 stratum, because B_4 is empty by (B). No assertion is made about irreducibility of B, the absolute dimension of B, the value of G beyond transitivity, whether cases (E)(ii) and (E)(iii) occur on the balanced locus, monomorphism or full faithfulness of the forgetful morphism on arbitrary families, quasi-finiteness as a morphism of stacks, closedness or non-closedness or codimension of its image in M_{6,6}, lci/Gysin or purity properties, or any Hodge, weight or Tate conclusion.
